title: oidc-siwe-app
tagline: A graphical attempt at understanding a bit more the process when using OpenID Connect and Sign-in with Ethereum
description:
The submission is two-fold:

Mainly a protocol flow diagram Diagram source heavily inspired by the one in Auth0 blog post https://auth0.com/blog/sign-in-with-ethereum-siwe-now-available-on-auth0/. This is a first draft for adding a diagram in https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4361 like eg in https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7636.html.  And an example app in Vue.js deployed on cloudflare pages using auth0 integration of Spruce https://oidc.login.xyz/
